name: program-runtime.batch-inference
purpose: Classify up to 32 texts in one ordered ai.batch call with the classify.fast role and report labels in input order; the batch-inference construction pattern.

corpus.description: Texts to classify, 1 to 32. Default: three failure sentences.

labels.description: Closed label set rendered into the enum schema.

assumptions: ai-gateway is running with a provider that serves classify.fast
invariants: results are read in input order: run-batch rows are the per-item RunResponse records, read with head(len(corpus)); nothing beyond the corpus length is materialized
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.labels: one label per text in corpus order
signals.validated: count of results the gateway validated against the schema
